issues.display_title: Issue #952: Secured Published Project — password-protected published projects
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

RESULT

Branch: design/secured-published

Add a Secured Project option for published projects. Owners can turn it on from the Share Published Project modal and set a password. Visitors who open the normal share link then see a password page before the map opens; correct access is remembered on that device.

Secured is a third state distinct from private (not publicly viewable) and unpublished (offline). A secured project stays published, keeps share-link previews, and gets its own secured links for Embed Map / Embed to Virtual Tour so the normal share link can't be used as an embed shortcut.

Docs: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-09-07-secured-published-project/brief.md · docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-09-07-secured-published-project/prd.md

Scope

In scope

  • Secured Project section in the Share Published Project modal (toggle + password, save/off)
  • Password with no complexity rules
  • Locked-project password page for visitors (no attempt limit)
  • Remembered access per browser/device after a correct password
  • Share-link previews keep showing project metadata (name/description), never map content
  • Secured embed links for Embed Map and Embed to Virtual Tour (normal share link must not work as an embed shortcut)

Out of scope

  • Viewer sign-in / accounts
  • Password attempt limits
  • Password complexity/length rules
  • Per-viewer access lists, approved-website embed lists
  • Expiring passwords / access windows
  • Separate passwords per surface (share vs. embed vs. tour)
  • Changes to private/unpublished behavior or collaborator permissions

Acceptance Criteria

  • Share Published Project modal includes a Secured Project section
  • Owner can turn secured access on/off for a published project
  • Owner can set a project password (no complexity rules)
  • Secured project remains published; normal share link still exists
  • Visitor without saved access sees the locked-project password page (clear "locked" + password prompt)
  • Map content is not shown before the correct password is entered
  • Correct password opens the project; wrong password shows a clear error and allows unlimited retries
  • Correct access is remembered in the same browser/device (no re-prompt while saved access is valid)
  • If saved access is missing or rejected, the password page appears again
  • Secured projects still show recognizable link-preview metadata
  • Embed Map and Embed to Virtual Tour use special secured links when the project is locked
  • Normal share link cannot be used as a shortcut to embed a secured project
  • Public (non-secured), private, and unpublished projects keep their current behavior unchanged

References

  • Brief: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-09-07-secured-published-project/brief.md
  • PRD: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-09-07-secured-published-project/prd.md
